notes: The daily opportunity Reel's shared voice-over (social/facebook). 'Rokct' is pronounced 'rocket', so the script spells it that way. The sting plays on every post kind, so it never says 'funding' (a tender is not funding); a line that short on its own does not hold the clone, so the sting renders as a sentence and keep_through cuts it after 'Rocket'. Each line's first passing take is written as its asset, which the daily Reel workflow downloads in place of the committed voice files.

lines.text: Hi, this is Rocket, with today's opportunity.
Looking for funding? Here's one you can apply for, right now.
Looking for a tender? Here's one you can bid on, right now.
Follow Rocket for more funding opportunities every day.
